requirements.title: The processor-dependent error-reporting unit is preconnected for sequential formatted output
requirements.definition: The standard identifies a processor-dependent external unit for error reporting; it shall be preconnected for sequential formatted output and is identified by ERROR_UNIT.

pending.error-unit-preconnected-formatted-output: Left pending: a write can check successful formatted output, but this packet does not assert a physical stderr/stdout destination because ERROR_UNIT may be the same as the output unit.
